dedupe_keys.name: canadian er closures and service disruptions erstat

description: ERstat publishes point-in-time records of Canadian emergency-room closures and reduced service, collected from official health-authority sources across the provinces and territories. Jason Turnbull's September 2026 Zenodo deposit contains closures.csv, coverage.csv and a README. Closure records include a status message and an expected reopening when one has been published; the coverage table describes provincial coverage and freshness. The snapshot is free for non-commercial reuse with attribution under CC BY-NC 4.0. The provider separately offers a live JSON API requiring a free key and other products under a separate licence. This draft covers the deposited snapshot, not unrestricted access to the full event history. A modeller could use service disruptions to define hospital-availability scenarios. A snapshot cannot establish closure duration by itself. No related catalogue record is identified by the deposit.
